aboutSection.aboutDesc1: I am many things, but of those most likely relevant to you - a Minecraft mod developer and content creator.
aboutSection.aboutDesc2: I have a particular passion for creating immersive RPG experiences, structures, and tools. Most of my experience involves pushing the boundaries of what is possible within the game.
aboutSection.aboutDesc3: These days you can find me tending to my Discord server, where I chat about all things human, as well as announce new developments in my projects. You can also check out my videos on my YouTube channel where I occasionally post updates and gameplay!

project-boss-rpg.title: PROJECT BOSS RPG
project-boss-rpg.description: An epic RPG modpack with unique boss progression, custom gear, and questlines.

sdob.title: SPIRAL DUNGEON OF BABEL
sdob.description: Explore the tallest dungeon tower ever created! Available for Minecraft Java, Bedrock, and Datapack.

structural-beyond.title: STRUCTURAL BEYOND
structural-beyond.description: Adds dozens of unique, breathtaking structures to your world across Java, Bedrock, and Datapacks!

project-horror.title: PROJECT HORROR
project-horror.description: Terrifying survival horror experience packed with scariest entities, custom atmosphere, and mechanics.

project-the-rpg-reborn.title: PROJECT THE RPG REBORN
project-the-rpg-reborn.description: Incredible RPG experience alone or with friends featuring leveling, magic, dungeons, and bosses.

project-realistic-rpg.title: PROJECT REALISTIC RPG
project-realistic-rpg.description: Realistic survival experience with health, weapons, medkits, temperature, and immersive mechanics.

project-gunparty.title: PROJECT GUNPARTY
project-gunparty.description: Action-packed multiplayer gun warfare and deathmatch experience inside Minecraft.

bosstweak-3d.title: BOSSTWEAK 3D+
bosstweak-3d.description: Official resource pack of Boss RPG: corrects visual problems, improves textures, and adds 3D models.

pmaintanceuniversal.title: PROJECT MAINTENANCE UNIVERSAL
pmaintanceuniversal.description: Universal server maintenance plugin for Minecraft Java servers with customizable MOTDs.

infinitysmart.title: INFINITYSMART SERVER
infinitysmart.description: Crossplatform European Minecraft Java & Bedrock network featuring InfinitySMP and minigames.
